title: The Armour of God Bible Crossword Puzzle — Free on iOS
heading: The Armour of God Bible Crossword
description: Solve an Armour of God Bible crossword: the belt of truth, breastplate of righteousness, shield of faith and sword of the Spirit. KJV clues, free on iPhone and iPad.
prose: Paul writes to the Ephesians from prison and reaches for a soldier's kit to describe how to stand: loins girt with truth, the breastplate of righteousness, feet shod, the shield, the helmet, the sword. The Armour of God is a grid built piece by piece out of Ephesians 6 — and because Paul names each item with what it stands for, every clue teaches while you solve it.

Note the KJV spelling in the title: armour, with a u. That is worth remembering across the whole app — answers follow the King James Version, so Saviour, honour and armour all keep their extra letter, and a word that seems one square too long is usually right after all.

clues.text: What your loins are to be girt about with
The shield that quenches the fiery darts

verseText: Put on the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.
